page.layout: One page: the front board of a bound book, a tooled leather cover with a central vase ornament and a blind-stamped frame; no printed text. Clasp and strap visible at the left edge.
page.notes: Scan shows the outer leather binding of the book, not a printed page. An ornamental vase stamp appears at the centre of the cover. No printed text, title, page number or running head is legible. Clasp and worn corners are part of the binding, not printed matter.
